tiger-primary-roads.notes: TIGER/Line Primary Roads national file — contains all interstates as LineString with RTTYP field. RTTYP='I' = interstate.

nbi.notes: FHWA NBI — download manually from https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/bridge/nbi/ascii.cfm. Select 'Delimited' format, download national file, save as data/cache/nbi_2023_national.csv.

bea-gdp-county.notes: BEA CAINC4 — Personal Income and Employment by County. Use for GDP per capita proxy (per capita personal income). 2022 data year.

usda-rural-codes.notes: USDA ERS Rural-Urban Continuum Codes 2023. RUCC 1-3 = metro, 4-9 = rural. Convert xlsx to csv before use.

atri-bottlenecks.notes: ATRI Top 100 Truck Bottleneck Report 2024 — hand-curated CSV at data/atri-bottlenecks.csv. No download URL (proprietary PDF); data extracted manually. See data/atri-bottlenecks.csv.
